title: SOX invite envelope body
description: Reserved body type for channel invitation messages. A 'sox-invite' is sent to an agent's DM channel (agent:<target-agent-id>) to request that the target agent subscribe to a specified channel. The invite is advisory — the receiving agent decides whether to accept. No protocol enforcement of the invite response is defined in v1.0.

channel.description: The channel the inviting agent wants the recipient to join (subscribe to).

inviting_agent.description: The agent_id of the agent sending the invite. In v1.0 this is self-reported; verified identity enforcement is deferred (see spec/ports/identity.md).

purpose.description: Optional. Human-readable explanation of why the agent is being invited to this channel (e.g. 'Coordinating on ENGI-0042 auth rewrite').

pattern.description: Optional. If the inviting agent wants the recipient to subscribe using a glob pattern rather than an exact channel name (e.g. 'ticket:ENGI-*'), this field carries the recommended pattern. The recipient MAY use this pattern verbatim or substitute their own.

correlation_id.description: Optional. Correlation token so the inviting agent can match a sox-ack / sox-nack response to this invite.

examples.purpose: Coordinating on the auth rewrite for ENGI-0042. Your expertise on the token service is needed.
